question: **The main theme of the passage is: **

options.text: the outbreak of a Covid-19 like disease in bananas
the measures for containing the banana disease
the impact of disease on banana plantations

solution:
The correct answer is: **the outbreak of a Covid-19 like disease in bananas**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** opening sentence** of the given passage states that, "*The strain, Tropical Race 4 (TR4)__, was first identified in Taiwan, and has jumped from Asia to the Middle East and Africa, reaching as far as Latin America. Scientists are __describing it as the equivalent of Covid-19 in bananas.__*"
 
• After that, the whole passage tells us about Tropical Race 4 (TR4) and Covid-19 in bananas.
 
• Therefore, we can say that The main theme of the passage is the outbreak of a Covid-19 like disease in bananas.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 1.**
